overview.description: A comprehensive full-stack sports betting platform with AI-powered betting advice, real-time odds, responsible gambling features, ML-driven matchup predictions, and a RAG-enhanced chatbot assistant.
overview.communication: RESTful API with JSON (dual backend: Rust + Python pipeline)
overview.authentication: JWT bearer tokens (shared secret between Rust backend and Node.js chatbot)
overview.data_encryption: AES-256-GCM for sensitive wallet balances at rest

security: Rate limiting with Governor (per-IP and per-user)
Security headers middleware (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame, etc.)
Account lockout on failed login attempts

chatbot.rag: Hybrid search (pgvector + PostgreSQL full-text) with Reciprocal Rank Fusion

subdirs.src/: Application source (main.rs, handlers/, middleware/, models, services)
subdirs.src/handlers/: HTTP handlers for all API routes (auth, betting, wallet, parlay, chat, intelligence, admin)
subdirs.scripts/: Helper scripts (migration runner, TLS cert generator)

frontend/.purpose: React SPA for sports betting UI

subdirs.src/pages/: 27 page components (Login, Register, Dashboard, Odds, BetHistory, Predictions, ParlayCalculator, DeviggedOdds, EVBets, Arbitrage, BestBets, SmartAssistant, CollegeSports, MarchMadnessBracket, FPLAdvisor, 9 admin pages)
subdirs.src/components/: 17+ reusable components (Navbar, ErrorBoundary, BetCard, BetConfirmationModal, WalletModal, AgeVerificationModal, RoleSwitcher, WhatIfPredictor, plus admin/ and parlay/ subdirs)
subdirs.src/components/parlay/: Parlay components (ParlayBuilderSidebar, ParlayBetLeg, ParlayResults, SuggestedParlays, QuickAddSearch)
subdirs.src/hooks/: React Query hooks (useAuth, useBetting, useIntelligence, usePredictions, useParlayCalculator, useParlayData)
subdirs.src/utils/: Utilities (api.js, constants.js, validation.js with Zod schemas)

subdirs.etl/: 23 ETL modules (fetch_raw_data, ingest_oddsapi_offers, match_oddsapi_events, compute_intelligence, compute_intelligence_v2, transform, load_to_db, update_results, fetch_nba_data_wrapper, fetch_basketball_reference*, fetch_ncaa*, fetch_fpl_data, fetch_nba_cup_data, elo_model, true_probability, backtesting, ncaab_predictor, data_validator, utils, cache, fpl_optimizer)
subdirs.models/: ML training and prediction (train_model.py, train_model_v2.py, predict.py, predict_v2.py, model_store/)
subdirs.api/: FastAPI server exposing ML predictions and betting intelligence endpoints
subdirs.data/: Raw fetched data and processed Parquet files

subdirs.flows/: Conversation flow implementations (chat.js - legacy Genkit, chat-rag.js - active RAG flow)
subdirs.services/: Backing services (cache.js - Redis, embeddings.js, retrieval.js, knowledge-retrieval.js, router.js)

data_flow.odds_ingestion: The Odds API → fetch_raw_data (raw JSON) → ingest_oddsapi_offers (provider_events + odds_offers) → match_oddsapi_events (canonical events) → compute_intelligence (devigged_odds, ev_bets, arbitrage)
data_flow.ml_pipeline: fetch_raw_data → transform (feature engineering → Parquet) → load_to_db (football_betting) → train_model (XGBoost/Ensemble) → predict (predictions table) → sync_to_backend (canonical events)
data_flow.chatbot_request: Frontend → Rust backend (JWT proxy) → Node.js chatbot → query route → Redis cache check → PostgreSQL hybrid retrieval → Gemini 2.0 Flash → cache response → return
data_flow.betting_flow: User → select odds → place bet → validate event/limits → deduct wallet → create bet record → settle on event completion

state_management.backend: Stateless REST (JWT sessions tracked via in-memory DashMap)
state_management.frontend: Zustand stores (auth, betting, parlay with localStorage persist, settings with localStorage persist) + TanStack Query cache
state_management.chatbot: Redis cache for RAG responses + PostgreSQL for persistent data

storage.primary_database: PostgreSQL with two databases: football_betting (pipeline data) and football_heritage (user data, canonical events, betting intelligence)
storage.cache: Redis for chatbot response caching and RAG acceleration
storage.file_cache: File-based JSON cache for API responses in pipeline (with TTL and SHA-256 key hashing)
storage.model_store: Serialized ML models in pipeline/models/model_store/ (.pkl format)

rebuild_steps.backend: cd backend; cp .env.example .env; cargo sqlx database create; cargo sqlx migrate run; cargo run --release
rebuild_steps.frontend: cd frontend; npm install; npm run dev
rebuild_steps.chatbot: cd chatbot; npm install; npm run dev
rebuild_steps.pipeline: cd pipeline; pip install -r requirements.txt; python -m api.main

security_notes: All .env files contain secrets (DB passwords, API keys, JWT secrets, encryption keys) - ensure they are never committed
Wallet balances are encrypted with AES-256-GCM - the ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 32 bytes and backed up safely
JWT_SECRET must match across backend/ and chatbot/ for auth to work
CORS is configured explicitly via ALLOWED_ORIGINS in all services (no wildcard origins)
Rate limiting is applied at multiple levels: global IP (100/min), per-user betting (5/min), per-IP login (10/min)
Playwright tests are written but config is disabled - re-enable for E2E testing
.env port mismatch: frontend uses 8888 but .env.example/docs reference 8080
VITE_PIPELINE_API_URL missing from frontend .env (defined in .env.example but not in .env)
Frontend README references React 18/React Router v6 - outdated vs actual React 19/React Router v7

core_modules: auth.rs - JWT auth service with session management (DashMap)
betting_simple.rs - Betting service with transactional safety
crypto.rs - AES-256-GCM encryption + Argon2id password hashing
models.rs - All data models and DTOs
utils.rs - IP extraction, age validation, session helpers

handlers.auth: Register, login, logout, refresh token, verify email
handlers.betting: Place bet, get events, get bets
handlers.intelligence: Devigged odds, EV bets, arbitrage queries + refresh trigger

middleware: rate_limit - Global per-IP rate limiting (100 req/min)
migrations: 20241019_initial_schema.sql - Core tables (users, wallets, transactions, events, bets, limits, activity)

model_v2.algorithm: Stacking Ensemble (XGBoost, RandomForest, GradientBoosting, LightGBM + LogisticRegression meta)
model_v2.features: 38 features (base form + ELO + odds engineering + head-to-head + venue)

etl_modules: fetch_raw_data - Odds API + football-data.org fetching with file cache
ingest_oddsapi_offers - Inserts provider events and odds offers into Heritage DB
match_oddsapi_events - Links provider events to canonical events
compute_intelligence - Devigs 2-way markets, computes EV, detects arbitrage
compute_intelligence_v2 - Enhanced with Elo + true probability ensemble
transform - Feature engineering to Parquet files
load_to_db - Batch upserts into football_betting database
elo_model - League-specific Elo ratings with form adjustments
true_probability - Ensemble estimator (sharp 40%, consensus 25%, Elo 20%, power 10%, Shin 5%)
backtesting - Brier Score, Log Loss, ROI, calibration curves
scheduling: Python scheduler (schedule library) - daily at 08:00, weekly retrain Sunday 02:00
Windows batch scripts for Task Scheduler

chatbot.rag_pipeline: Query routing → Redis cache check → PostgreSQL hybrid retrieval (pgvector + full-text) → Knowledge base retrieval → User context → Gemini 2.0 Flash → Cache storage
chatbot.intent_routing: Classifies queries as games, betting, statistics, account, help, or general with team/sport/time extraction

backend_rust.endpoints: ~40+ endpoints covering auth, betting, wallet, user, limits, sports, parlay, chat, intelligence, admin

pipeline_python.endpoints: ~12 endpoints: health, matches, predictions, history-data, accuracy-data, versions, best-value-bets, predict-matchup, update-results, intelligence (devig/ev/arbitrage)
